selection_basis: Prefer workspace-grounded questions whose wording or location is unknown and which require semantic, relational, chronological, comparative, or cross-file synthesis. Deprioritize exact filenames, fixed schemas, exhaustive enumeration, counting, and joins that native Glob/Grep/Read handle directly.
